remarks:
Exceptional Custom Lancaster Contemporary Estate on 11+ Private Acres with Ellicott Creek Views!

Experience unmatched,serene privacy, breathtaking Ellicott Creek views,beautiful sunsets, abundant wildlife at this extraordinary custom-designed 3-bedroom, 3 bath contemporary estate situated on over 11 acres. Thoughtfully designed with exceptional craftsmanship and high-end finishes throughout,this residence offers the perfect combination of luxury, comfort, and functionality. Your own private sanctuary !

A dramatic great room welcomes you with soaring 16-foot ceilings, a spectacular wall of windows showcasing the natural surroundings, elegant stone hydronic radiant-heated floors, 9-foot pocket doors, a gas fireplace, dry bar, and wine refrigerator. Large flat screen TVs included in sale . The gourmet kitchen features granite countertops, commercial-grade appliances, instant purified hot and cold water, and a dedicated Keurig waterline.

The luxurious primary suite offers a spa-like bath and exercise room and  two HUGE walk-in closets,while two additional spacious bedrooms share a connecting bathroom. Additional amenities include TOTO Smart  bidet commodes and an energy-efficient, five-zone  gas hydronic heating and cooling system.

Step outside to an incredible full-length stone patio designed for entertaining, complete with a gas fire pit, outdoor kitchen, stone fountain, hot tub included and garden sprinkler system. Enjoy the peaceful sights and sounds of Ellicott Creek, picturesque natural views, and wildlife right in your own backyard.

An extraordinary 6,000-square-foot garage outbuilding offers endless possibilities with three separate bays, heat and accommodations for a full-size RV or tractor-trailer with RV dumping. The first bay features a two-story workshop with a spot for a car lift, high-end built in cabinetry and half bath. The second provides exceptional space for large vehicle storage, with climate and humidity controls. This private oasis  is conveniently located close to all Lancaster amenities,major highways ,downtown and is minutes from Buffalo Airport.Video  tour included.
